description: This Kotlin source file defines an internal singleton object 'HttpClient' which provides static methods for performing HTTP GET and POST requests, encapsulating connection setup and response handling. Additionally, it defines a data class 'HttpResponse' to wrap HTTP response data.

classes.name: HttpResponse
classes.description: A data class representing the HTTP response, including status code and body.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URL with optional headers and returns an HttpResponse.

methods.name: postJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with a JSON body to the specified URL with optional headers, returning an HttpResponse.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with specified method, URL, headers, and optional body, returning an HttpResponse.
